transcript: He leaked the biggest video game on earth from a hotel room using nothing but a TV stick and a phone. You see, he was 18, already on bail for hacking and hiding in that hotel under police protection. So he plugged the stick into the TV, grabbed a keyboard and slipped into Rockstar's private chat. Then he dropped over 90 clips of the secret game for the whole internet to see. Rockstar says the leak cost them $5 million and thousands of hours of work. But the court said he wasn't fit to stand trial. So instead of prison, he was locked in a secure hospital, maybe for life, and the leak didn't kill the game. A year later, the real trailer became the most watched non -music video on YouTube in a single day. Then this year, doctors decided he was fit for trial after all, and he was moved back to prison. And just three days before GTA 6 finally came out, he pleaded guilty. So the guy who showed the world GTA 6 first will probably be the last one to play it.
